		+++ Expression Bank +++


Paste each chunk of code above the "void setup()" section.
It will write the images into the arduino's larger memory.
For the arduino nano or arduino uno, that is 30kB of usable space.

Use this code to save your image into the arduino:

const long NAME[] PROGMEM = {

// PASTE YOUR IMAGE DATA HERE

};

Use this code to display the image: 

for (int i = 0; i < NUM_LEDS; i++) {
  leds[i] = pgm_read_dword(&(NAME[i]));
}
